Question 1
?

f(y,z)=⟨_____,y,z⟩

The vector-valued function f(y,z) above parametrizes the hyperbolic paraboloid defined in Cartesian coordinates as 2x=3y2−4z2. What is the first component of f?

a
34y2−z2
b
32y2−2z2
c
y2−2z2
d
32y2−4z2
e
3y2−2z2
